_provenance: Hand-maintained by the site maintainer. First round: the corpus's Batch G Phase 2 runs of 2026-09-24: corpus v0.2.1, runner gpconf 0.2.1, all seventeen cases, one run per library at the version named, through a harness or adapter of the corpus's own over the library's unmodified parser. Recorded in the corpus decision log D-128 and D-132 to D-141 (public main at d8ce693), and astroz's run of release v0.14.0 in D-166 (public main at a4b3b76, which the page's link now opens); the specifics of each finding are in the linked report, where the project's maintainer can see them. Counts are results for that version on that date, not verdicts on the project; skip means the library has no reader for the case's format; not exercised is the runner's own data check (D-129). Every finding was reproduced by running the library's own code before it was reported. PyEphem (D-128) joined on 2026-09-25, when its report was filed. The gate column (corpus D-142) is read from the record counts each run recorded, not re-run: loaded means returned with the expected integer id, misidentified means returned as 0, NaN, a string or a wrong number, dropped means no record came back; its words name the behaviour, never grade the project. Refused and dropped are not distinguished for the first-round runs, which were recorded before the runner's refusal channel (corpus D-144); a dropped count may include records the library refused with an error. Pull requests are listed beside the reports with their state and date in parentheses, in the shape the weekly table uses for python-sgp4 ("PR #172 (merged 2026-09-24; fixed in master, awaiting a release)"): open means in review, not merged; merged means in the library's source but in no release yet; released means a published release carries the fix; in every case the row stays as run against the version named, and moves only when a run of the release is published. A report whose subject a release has since addressed, or left open, carries its state in the same shape. States read from the GitHub API on 2026-09-25; satellite.js PR #186 read again on 2026-09-26: merged that day as e5927a1 into develop, and no release since 7.1.0 of 2026-07-23 (GitHub releases and npm). libsgp4 read again on 2026-09-26, from the repository, its GitHub releases and the issue and pull-request pages: the maintainer merged pull request #46, from the maintainer's own branch, into master that day (1c0d4ee) and published release v3.0 (c6ebb90), which decodes Alpha-5; built from the tag with the corpus's harness, it passes every Alpha-5 decode vector in the corpus and reads all 604 derived Alpha-5 element sets with the right numbers. PR #42 is still open. Issue #45 is open: v3.0 fixes the CSV epoch without a fraction (a change dated 2026-08-02) and leaves the TLE epoch's 8 µs rounding as it was. The libsgp4 row stays as run against master 661e057 and PR #42's head. astroz read again on 2026-09-26, from the GitHub API and PyPI: the maintainer merged pull request #99 into main that day (4ca34f2), closed issues #97 and #98 as completed, and published release v0.13.0 (22e8ee0), also on PyPI. Built from the tag and run through the corpus's harness and probes, it passes every Alpha-5 decode vector in the corpus and reads all 604 derived Alpha-5 element sets with the right numbers; its epoch field is within 20 µs of the exact value on all 910 TLE element sets in the corpus, and the month-end dates of #98 fall on their own day. astroz read again on 2026-09-27, from the GitHub API and PyPI: release v0.14.0 (67ca74c) published that day, also on PyPI. The astroz row now reports a run of that release (owner decision): built from the tag with Zig 0.16.0 behind the corpus's harness, which reads the second derivative of mean motion the release added, and run with the runner the other rows used; the count is the same as at d558933, 9 of 17, and the reports' labels are unchanged. Second round, 2026-09-27: the corpus re-ran the eight libraries against corpus v0.4.0, released that day, and its eighteen cases, with runner gpconf 0.4.0 (corpus D-174 to D-185). The libsgp4 and astroz rows report it (owner decision, S-056, S-057): libsgp4 at release v3.0 (c6ebb90; corpus D-182 and D-183), in place of master and PR #42, which the round dropped; astroz at release v0.14.0 (corpus D-185), in place of its run of that release with the older runner. The PyEphem row reports it since its second-round report was filed on 2026-09-28 (https://github.com/brandon-rhodes/pyephem/issues/297; S-059): ephem 4.2.1 through the corpus's pyephem preset (corpus D-174, D-175, D-183). The other five rows stay at the first round until each library's second-round report is filed (S-056). Each row names its corpus version, and the page's link opens the decision log at public main 63454b1, where D-174 and D-178 carry their reports' links (corpus D-193). The second-round harnesses of libsgp4 and astroz and the pyephem preset report the library's refusals, so for those rows refused and dropped are told apart. States read again on 2026-09-27 from the GitHub API: dnwrnr/sgp4 issues #44 and #45 and pull request #42 open. PyEphem issues #296 and #297 open, read 2026-09-28.
